description: Customer mistyped VPA — sent ₹499 to an unrelated individual instead of the merchant.

customer_report.message: I made a typo while entering the UPI ID. ₹499 was sent to the wrong person and now I cannot reach them.

notes: scenario_hint: WRONG_RECIPIENT. Typo in VPA sent payment to wrong person. Merchant cannot recover. Official NPCI/bank route guidance needed.
